ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio, approximately 85% high-intensity white to 15% low-intensity black/dark grey across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous white field surrounded by a black border along the trailing edge. Distinctive punctate black spots (mottling) are distributed across the white surface, notably a cluster of roughly 5-7 spots on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, deep V-shaped depression at the center-point of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Significant irregular serrations. The left lobe trailing edge features 3-4 deep, jagged valleys. The right lobe trailing edge displays more frequent, lower-amplitude undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile on the outer margins, tapering into a slight concavity approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters detected across the white expanse of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear streaks observed, primarily on the left lobe, including a prominent horizontal mark near the lower edge and multiple diagonal scratches near the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular indentation or missing section on the outer leading edge of the left lobe. A small yellowish organic attachment is visible on the extreme tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A vertical black pigmentation streak extending from the base of the median notch towards the lower visible boundary.
